prompt:
Create an original production UI source atlas for Mochi Mayhem, a cute fruit fantasy mobile survival game. Expressive hand-painted anime ink contour style, brisk dry-brush strokes, restrained ivory rim highlights, charcoal/plum interiors (#18151f), tiny mint and warm coral accents. Elegant, compact and readable; same friendly fruit fantasy world, not horror. Original designs, no existing franchise insignia, no Japanese letters, no sword emblem, no large decorations.
Exact canvas 1536x1024 RGBA transparent background. FOUR separated horizontal rows, each 256px high. Keep at least 24px fully transparent clear gutter at every row boundary. Nothing overlaps another row. Absolutely NO TEXT, numerals, icons or symbols.
ROW 1 y0-255: one very slim horizontal dark ink HUD ribbon, from x40 to1496, y72 to184. Straight clean spacious center, softly hand-brushed angled ends, thin warm ivory outline at top/bottom, almost no splashes; tiny muted mint stroke at far left only. 9-slice-friendly middle.
ROW 2 y256-511: one slim mission ribbon from x40 to1496, y310 to450. Dark charcoal-plum translucent-looking painted center, very thin irregular ivory line, left tip a restrained teal ink sweep, no drawings in center. No gold ornamental filigree. 9-slice-friendly middle.
ROW 3 y512-767: one slim boss name and health backdrop from x40 to1496, y568 to708. Dark charcoal with crisp warm ivory ink contours and extremely subtle coral accent at far left/right. Center clean dark, no built-in health fill, no skull, no decoration that would overlap numbers. Not a huge ornate plate. 9-slice-friendly middle.
ROW 4 y768-1023: THREE small circular UI button bases, centered exactly at (256,896), (768,896), (1280,896), each no more than192px diameter, all fully within its 256x256 local square. Left normal: charcoal disc, thin ivory painted circular contour with slight brush taper. Middle active: same disc with a small muted mint highlight around upper-left contour. Right pressed: same disc slightly inset, warm coral-ivory highlight. Empty centers, no icons. Keep everything outside these objects truly transparent.
Anti-aliased clean usable edges. Sophisticated original anime ink accents at very small mobile HUD size, not chunky black blobs, not bright glowing magic effects. This is a reusable source asset atlas, not a screenshot or mockup.
